claim: Time position tells the viewer-facing devices — cards, grade shifts, musical reprise — when we are relative to the spine of the story. It is how a jump announces itself without a line of dialogue, and how a recurring scene earns its reprise instead of feeling like a mistake in the edit.
not_visual: Relational, not visual: earlier and later are only meaningful against another shot. In isolation a still cannot say which side of the spine it sits on, and the treatment that would sell it (haze, desaturation) actually belongs to story.reality_layer — rendering it here would just duplicate that card.
